title: History pane runs edge to edge along the top
goal: The History pane spans the full width of the screen and hugs the top edge, with no gap at the left, right or top (today about 48px each side and 12px above, measured by the user).
notes: User 2026-10-28 redline: 48px gaps left and right, 12px gap above the pane: "These gaps shouldn't be here, it should be edge to edge hugging the top." History is an NSPanel built by HistoryOverlayController. Related: history-pane-resizes-from-its-outer-edge (the outer edge is the bottom once it is edge to edge).
acceptance: No gap at the left, right or top of the screen, measured on a screenshot
Rounded corners only where the pane does not meet a screen edge
Still clears the menu bar correctly
